summary: Finance of America Reverse LLC (FAR), an indirect subsidiary of Finance of America Companies Inc., entered into an amendment to acquire from Onity Mortgage Corporation (OMC) mortgage servicing rights on ~20,000 HECM loans with $5.1 billion UPB, plus OMC's reverse origination pipeline. Consideration is estimated book value adjusted for holdbacks and post-closing adjustments. OMC will subservice the MSRs for three years with auto-renewal. Close subject to Ginnie Mae consent and customary conditions; termination date August 1, 2026. Watch for regulatory approvals and post-close adjustments.
